collection_runner_recovery.scope: All 35 prescribed jobs were launched by one collector process before subsequent runner-file edits; confirmed by the root operator.
collection_runner_recovery.legacy_field_semantics: The original code hashes the current on-disk runner file when each receipt is created. This field does not identify the module already executing in memory.
collection_runner_recovery.correction: campaign.runner_sha256 identifies the actual startup module, recovered byte-for-byte from the matching git blob. Original receipts remain unchanged; promoted evidence labels their observed hashes as runner_file_sha256_at_receipt.

provenance.prior_record_reference: Previous published records remain in Git history; original files are retained in the private campaign archive.

publication_source_annotations.definition: Eight current simulation sources have explanatory comment corrections. Executed collection files and all numerical commands remain unchanged; exact source identities and diffs are retained.

target_check_three_decimal_agreements.definition: Number of horizons 0,1,2 whose exported empirical and population targets have equal three-decimal representations.

lpdid_n1000_bias.definition: Balanced no-covariate LP event-time 0 at N=1000; bias is mean estimate minus target 2.0, bias MCSE is sample SD/sqrt(finite estimates).

lpdid_n1000_bias_mcse.definition: Balanced no-covariate LP event-time 0 at N=1000; bias is mean estimate minus target 2.0, bias MCSE is sample SD/sqrt(finite estimates).

lpdid_n4000_bias.definition: Balanced no-covariate LP event-time 0 at N=4000; bias is mean estimate minus target 2.0, bias MCSE is sample SD/sqrt(finite estimates).

lpdid_n4000_bias_mcse.definition: Balanced no-covariate LP event-time 0 at N=4000; bias is mean estimate minus target 2.0, bias MCSE is sample SD/sqrt(finite estimates).

master_jwdid_uc_e2_mean_se_sd_ratio.definition: Mean finite reported SE divided by sample SD of finite estimates for master/jwdid_uc/event-time2; component denominators are recorded in the metric.

mech.kind: intended two-period cohort and diagnostic extraction
mech.definition: Generate the intended g=2 treatment cohort for T=2 while preserving N3000/seed77 and every T>=3 branch; read the literal single-horizon JWD table directly; evaluate the diagnostic string expression correctly.

eqgate.definition: Both literal-command paths reset the same RNG seed and sortseed before estimation; all 81 finite estimate/SE comparisons remain exact, with no tolerance.

coverage_policy: Coverage conditions on finite estimates with finite positive standard errors, as in the published summarizer; attempted and declined counts retain every configured draw.

duplicate_policy.definition: Baseline comparison drivers own their baseline arms. Option drivers contribute their additional named variants; their repeated baseline fits are cross-run diagnostics. This purpose-based rule does not depend on observed truth, precision or success.
duplicate_policy.numeric_policy: No tolerance, rounding, averaging or backfilling. Missing or refused canonical rows remain missing or refused. Within-file duplicate keys and unregistered cross-producer overlaps refuse. All full per-job raw outputs remain retained.
duplicate_policy.cross_run_policy: Repeated baseline fits in separate scripts are retained as measured cross-run comparisons. Canonical ownership follows the stated script purpose and does not require cross-run equality of floating-point results.
